_comment: Read-only ClickHouse dictionary health alert. Replace __CLICKHOUSE_DS_UID__ and __FOLDER_UID__ during provisioning. NOT_LOADED dictionaries are healthy.

rules.title: ClickHouse dictionary failed, stale, or oversized

annotations.summary: ClickHouse dictionary health check found {{ $values.B.Value }} failing dictionaries
annotations.description: Inspect system.dictionaries for failed loads, updates stale over ten minutes, or allocations over 4 GiB. NOT_LOADED is intentionally healthy.

model.rawSql: SELECT count() AS failures FROM (SELECT database, name, status, element_count, bytes_allocated, loading_duration, last_successful_update_time, dateDiff('second', last_successful_update_time, now()) AS stale_seconds, substring(last_exception,1,300) AS last_exception FROM system.dictionaries WHERE last_exception != '' OR status IN ('FAILED','FAILED_AND_RELOADING') OR (status IN ('LOADED','LOADED_AND_RELOADING') AND last_successful_update_time < now() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE) OR bytes_allocated > 4294967296)
